messages:
anya: Heads-up: int4-alpha posted a tiny but repeatable regression on long-context policy summaries. saw it during the 2% canary. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/long-index-wrapping :frowning:
raj: spike was small but consistent on a specific cohort: route=longform_policy + seqlen>1600. hallucination-like outputs where model flips yes/no on a clause.
oliver: can you paste a minimal repro? need to see if it's token corruption or distributional noise.
anya: pasted two minimal repros inline and linked a longer gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/long-index-wrap-samples
---
ID: p-991
prompt (trimmed): "Given the policy below, is action X allowed?"
int4-alpha output: "No, it's disallowed."
float16 baseline: "Yes, allowed under clause 3.2."
---

ejva: quick read: there's a subtle off-by-one in the KV index math in the int4 accelerated kernel. previously seen with other quant kernels when context cross-page boundaries.
jess: A/B run results: on the 5k sample slice (seqlen heavy tail), int4-alpha concordance -0.015 vs f16, hallucination_delta +1.3pp concentrated at >1.6k. latency and throughput look fine.
raj: what's current canary gate for this route? iirc alert-only at +2pp over 10m and auto-fallback disabled for pilot.
ci-bot: config check: canary-rule(route=longform_policy): alert_threshold=+2.0pp/10m, auto_fallback=false (pilot).
oliver: proposal: add a targeted guard that watches a route-tagged slice + index-wrap indicator. trigger auto-fallback when hallucination_delta >= +1.0pp over 3x5m windows for the tagged slice only. fallback action: shift canary traffic to float16 replica and disable int4 kv-cache writes (`kv_cache.write=false`) for that pool.
anya: agree on tagged-slice only. also add a pre-fallback smoke cohort (N=120, seqlen sampled 1k-3k heavy tail) that runs continuously in shadow and can pre-empt a bad cut.
jess: implementation note: i'll add the slice tag `slice:long_policy_indexwrap_v1` and wire the smoke cohort. auto-fallback change requires ops toggle, i'll open a PR against canary-rules.
raj: rollout plan: 1) push rule change to staging, 2) run smoke cohort 1h in staging, 3) deploy to canary config at 09:00 PT tomorrow, shadow 45m, then 3% for 2h if stable. if smoke cohort shows delta >= +1.0pp persistently, abort and fallback.
oliver: rollback runbook assigned to me. steps: 1) flip canary traffic to float16-wt, 2) set `kv_cache.write=false` on int4 pool, 3) collect sample set and run diff-tool, 4) file postmortem and tag owners.
ci-bot: queued smoke cohort job 90021 for int4-alpha vs float16. ETA ~11m.
eva: i'll instrument an additional metric: "kv_index_mismatch_rate" computed from align-checks in the runtime so we can correlate. aim to have lightweight telemetry within 24h.
anya: good. once smoke run completes paste results here. if auto-fallback trips, please @eng-oncall and page. reconvene after smoke run or tomorrow 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
